title: Azure (service principal with Reader and Security Reader, ARM REST API)

checks.title: Each Microsoft Defender for Cloud plan the subscription's resources need is on (Standard tier)
checks.scope: One result per plan the subscription lists; deprecated plans are left out. Since 2026-10-26 a plan is required only when the subscription holds a resource type it protects (Resources - List filtered by type: for example virtual machines, scale sets and Arc machines for Servers, storage accounts for Storage, AKS clusters and registries for Containers); otherwise it is skipped as not needed. Defender for Resource Manager (Arm) is always required. CloudPosture and plans the collector has no mapping for are reported, not judged. Shows the plan is paid for and on, not that its alerts are triaged.

checks.title: The Defender for Cloud secure score is readable and at or above the set threshold
checks.scope: The ascScore of the subscription, compared with --azure-min-secure-score (default 0, so any readable score passes).

checks.title: The subscription's activity log is exported, Administrative events included
checks.scope: Subscription diagnostic settings with a Log Analytics workspace, storage account, event hub or partner destination. Resource-level diagnostic logs are not checked.

checks.title: Each key vault has soft delete and purge protection on
checks.scope: Key vaults in the subscription; keys, secrets and their rotation are not read.

checks.title: Each storage account accepts HTTPS only
checks.scope: Storage account endpoints; traffic through private endpoints or other services is not visible.

checks.title: Each storage account disallows anonymous blob access
checks.scope: The account-level allowBlobPublicAccess setting; SAS tokens and network rules are not judged.

checks.title: Each storage account requires TLS 1.2 or higher
checks.scope: The account's minimumTlsVersion; unset means TLS 1.0 and fails.

checks.title: Each Azure SQL database has transparent data encryption enabled
checks.scope: Azure SQL Database user databases (master excluded); SQL Managed Instance and SQL on VMs are not read.

checks.title: No network security group allows SSH (22) or RDP (3389) in from the Internet
checks.scope: Custom rules of each NSG (source *, Internet, Any, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0); Azure Firewall and NVA rules are not read.

checks.title: At least one Azure Policy assignment applies to the subscription
checks.scope: Assignments at or above the subscription; their compliance state is not read.

checks.title: Each managed disk is encrypted at rest (platform key, customer key, both, or Azure Disk Encryption)
checks.scope: Managed disks; Azure encrypts them with a platform key by default, so a fail means the API reported no encryption at all.

checks.title: Each Recovery Services vault protects at least one item, and the subscription has a vault
checks.scope: Azure Backup in Recovery Services vaults; Backup vaults (Microsoft.DataProtection), restore tests and retention are not read.

checks.title: No Azure SQL server firewall rule opens it to the whole internet
checks.scope: Server-level IP firewall rules of each Azure SQL logical server: a rule wider than 16,777,216 addresses (a /8) fails. A server with publicNetworkAccess Disabled passes without its rules being read, since only private endpoints connect then. The Allow Azure services rule (0.0.0.0) is reported, not failed, though it admits other customers' Azure services too (learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-sql/database/firewall-configure, read 2026-10-26). Database-level rules, virtual network rules, managed instances and Synapse are not read.

checks.title: Each running virtual machine has a recent patch assessment with no critical or security update pending
checks.scope: Running Azure VMs, from the instance view's patchStatus.availablePatchSummary (criticalAndSecurityPatchCount, status, lastModifiedTime; Virtual Machines - Instance View, read 2026-10-26). Fails when the VM has no assessment, the last one is older than 7 days or did not succeed, or a critical or security patch is pending; stopped VMs are skipped. The patch mode is reported. Arc-enabled servers and scale-set instances are not read.
